display_name: 宽时频恢复器加中层特征保护：单阶段30轮
description: 同一从零宽时频网络与源损失，新增冻结F0中层配对特征约束及逐样本IQ梯度上限，完整Main七景评估。
authorization: Existing authorized original L_s/U_s simulated pairs, independent F-guided scratch single30 and complete Main seven-view evaluation; no parameter limit.

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI Torch, FP32 network/FP64 posterior, TF32 disabled; one own worker, total compute cap3

data.representation: Original R07 L_s6300/U_s56700 clean/received plus simulator Action/noise; original global/other-RX source moments. One fixed1% source-RMS perturbation per row/epoch. Adds matched source F0 middle maps.

data.support_query_ref: No targettraining/support/PCD/unknownrole. OriginalMain two populations168000,all7perrowfixedbefore independenttruth.
data.actual_training_labels: Zero TX labels. Original physical action/noise, paired IQ/STFT, frozen F0 final/response plus clean/restored middle features; no class logits or CE in G loss.

permissions.query_use: Source RX selects training prior/mode factor only. Deployed G consumes current IQ and its fixed source buffers. No V/OE/target fit or TX truth.
permissions.claim_scope: No target training, source TX labels, V/OE fitting, F0 logits/CE, new identity head, or prior G weights. Deployed G consumes only received IQ and fixed source buffers.

checkpoint.initialization: All 6170283 G parameters scratch, same initialization and architecture as wide control; no previous G weights or optimizer.
sources: FROZEN_F0 original source-trained Tri-SIG-TIME SSL continuous final and middle features
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original VALIDATED_ONCE R07 source L_s/U_s and original F0/source moments. No control learned state loaded.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Scratch G; source simulator and frozen source F0 continuous features only, no TX/V/OE/target training.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final30/7410; all two-population seven-view predictions fixed before independent truth-last.

execution.gpu_policy: GPU4 or6, at most one existing compute PID before admission, >=12288 MiB free, one own worker, total cap3; stop only own worker.
execution.stop_rule: Source/F0/prior mismatch, output collision, real source2/E0/middle-gradient smoke failure, nonfinite, posterior residual>1e-8, GPU cap violation, GPU count unverifiable on three checks, or worker error: preserve and stop; no automatic retry. Otherwise final30 and complete Main7/truth-last.

notes: Added middle t2.pool clean/restored map MSE normalized by clean-map energy; coefficient .01, per-record IQ input-gradient cap .5, detached cap weight.
F-guided; no TX labels, F logits/CE, source V/OE or target data in G training. Existing training smoke can call frozen F0 default head without using logits as G loss.
One extra no-grad clean F0 forward plus one intermediate input-gradient evaluation per source microbatch; actual training cost is measured. G deployment makes no F0 call.
Original initialization, data order, loss, prior and 30 epochs match wide control; separate GPU and trajectory may differ.
Predictions and independent score automatic; target results cannot tune, select checkpoints or routes. Default DURA unchanged.
